caption:
I kept thinking it was just a beautiful lie, some glitchy projection of what the city used to be. Then I touched it. It wasn't soft; it was freezing, like a pane of deep-sea glass. When my palm hit the surface, the whole forest rippled like water and a low thrum rattled my teeth until my vision blurred into white noise. It’s not just a wall. It’s reacting. 

The membrane’s sudden pulse suggests a security system that might have just logged her biometrics. 

#NeoTokyo #GhostForest #GlitchReality #UrbanExploration #CyberpunkLife #Membrane #HiddenCity
